info.title: MyKP API Documentation
info.description: API documentation for the MyKP backend

get.summary: Search activities by title or type

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by activity title or type

id.description: ActivityID of the newly created activity

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid bearer token

422.description: Validation error — see `errors` map for per-field messages

post.summary: Upload (or replace) the poster image for an existing activity. Body is base64-encoded so Swagger UI can call it without multipart.
post.description: Upload image for an existing activity

parameters.name: activityId
parameters.description: ActivityID of the activity to attach the image to

event_poster.description: Server-relative path; resolved to an absolute URL when activities are listed

get.summary: Get activities created by authenticated admin
get.description: Get all activities created by the authenticated admin

post.summary: Revoke the current Sanctum access token (only this device's token, other sessions stay valid)

401.description: Unauthorized — no valid token in Authorization header

post.summary: Login with Google OAuth Access Token

accessToken.description: Google OAuth access token from the frontend SDK

422.description: Validation error (invalid token, wrong domain, or email not registered)

message.example: This Google account is not registered.

get.summary: List the authenticated user's saved (bookmarked) activities, newest-first by save time

post.summary: Save (bookmark) an activity for the authenticated user

422.description: Validation error — missing or non-existent activity_id

get.summary: Check whether the authenticated user has bookmarked a specific activity

delete.summary: Remove a bookmarked activity for the authenticated user

200.description: OK — bookmark removed (idempotent: returns 200 even if it wasn't bookmarked)

get.summary: List notifications and mark them all as read. Two kinds are interleaved: 'notification' (new activity created) and 'reminder' (3/2/1 days before a bookmarked activity's registration deadline).

200.description: OK — sorted newest first. Calling this endpoint marks every returned item as read.

id.description: Stable ID. 'act-{ActivityID}' for new-activity notifications, 'bm-{BookmarkID}-{days}d' for deadline reminders.

get.summary: Number of notifications the user hasn't viewed yet (drives the bell badge on the dashboard)

count.description: Number of currently-visible notifications not yet acknowledged by reading /api/notifications

post.summary: Register the authenticated user for an activity. Records a participation row and increments matching KP_Progress.

parameters.name: activity_id
parameters.description: ActivityID of the activity to register for

get.summary: List the authenticated user's participation history. Optionally filter by kp_category.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by kp_category (exact match on activity category name)

get.summary: Get a user's profile and KP category progress summary

jurusan.description: Study program code; null for admins
